title: Migration Deploy Plan
description: Schema for the Migration_Deploy_Plan.md structured data. Produced by migration-deploy-skill. Documents all pending migrations, their risk assessment, execution plan, and rollback strategy.

target_environment.description: Target environment for this migration deployment.

forbidden_command.description: Command that is forbidden in this environment.

current_migration_state.description: Current state of migrations in the target environment.

last_applied_migration.description: Filename of the last migration applied to the target database.

pending_count.description: Number of pending migration files not yet applied.

pending_migrations.description: Ordered list of migration files to be applied. Applied in chronological order by filename timestamp.

order.description: Application order (1 = first to be applied).

operations_summary.description: Human-readable summary of what SQL operations this migration performs.

is_destructive.description: True if migration contains DROP COLUMN, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, or narrowing ALTER.

destructive_operations.description: Specific destructive operations found (empty if is_destructive is false).

is_backward_compatible.description: True if current codebase works correctly with both old and new schema (allows parallel deploy).

affected_table_row_count.description: Approximate row count of the primary affected table (for duration estimate accuracy).

human_signoff_required.description: True if this migration requires human sign-off before execution (always true for CRITICAL, usually true for HIGH).

human_signoff_obtained.description: True if human sign-off has been documented. Required when human_signoff_required is true.

human_signoff_approver.description: Name/identifier of the human who approved this migration.

overall_risk.description: Overall risk for the migration deployment (max risk of all individual migrations).

rollback_strategy.description: Database rollback strategy — always forward-fix, never backward.

forward_fix_description.description: Description of the forward-fix migration that undoes the change.

forward_fix_sql_preview.description: Preview of the SQL that would be in the forward-fix migration.

forward_fix_migration_prepared.description: True if the forward-fix migration file is already prepared and ready.

human_signoff_required.description: True if any pending migration requires human sign-off before execution.

all_signoffs_obtained.description: True if all required human sign-offs have been documented.

execution_readiness.description: Whether the migration deployment is ready to execute.
